title: Owens declares war on US government, poltergeists on Navy vessels
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Owens declares war on US government, poltergeists on Navy vessels, about late 1970s-1980s at United States (Navy vessels, nuclear plants), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he said, "I'm declaring war against the United States government." And I would get newspaper clippings of poltergeist attacks on Navy vessels
